terminalOLOMWEB open-source philosophy

Every line of code you watch is on GitHub under an open license

We believe programming education is not complete by just watching. Therefore each episode and series lives in its own repository containing the full source, config files (Docker, Terraform), and a branch per lesson stage so you can experiment and compare instantly.
